page_title: UDI 0-2 JUV | Udinese v Juventus 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Federico Gatti (Juventus). Rosario Abisso doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Rui Modesto is brought on as a substitute for Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Timothy Weah departs the field of play to be replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
87' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Maduka Okoye (Udinese).
86' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
84' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Keinan Davis (Udinese) for a tough tackle.
83' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
81' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Andrea Cambiaso and he is replaced by Danilo (Juventus).
81' Today's match ends for Nicolo Savona who will be replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
80' Keinan Davis (Udinese) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
80' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes the corner.
79' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
79' Martin Payero (Udinese) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
79' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Rosario Abisso interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to Juventus.
77' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
75' The corner from Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.

74' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Hassane Kamara (Udinese) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
72' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
71' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) replaces Dusan Vlahovic.
70' It is time for a substitution. Weston McKennie (Juventus) is on for Khephren Thuram.
70' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

69' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Maduka Okoye. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
68' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
67' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jordan Zemura.
66' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
64' A pass by Timothy Weah (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Juventus get a free kick.
61' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
61' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
60' Keinan Davis (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
59' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
58' The foul by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Rosario Abisso.
57' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
56' Timothy Weah (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
55' Timothy Weah (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' The foul by Keinan Davis (Udinese) was seen by Rosario Abisso who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
51' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

50' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
50' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is comfortably saved by Maduka Okoye.
47' Today's referee Rosario Abisso rightly decides to book Jaka Bijol (Udinese) for his harsh tackle.
47' Martin Payero (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Martin Payero (Udinese) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing. Udinese have a corner.
46' Martin Payero (Udinese) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Michele Di Gregorio.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Christian Kabasele comes off for Enzo Ebosse (Udinese).
46' The game is over for Sandi Lovric. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes a short free kick.
45+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle after Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Udinese have a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Rough tackle by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded the free kick.
42' Maduka Okoye is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Timothy Weah (Juventus). Easy save!

42' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Rosario Abisso no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
41' Juventus are ruled offside.
41' Timothy Weah (Juventus) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Savona (Juventus) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
37' What a chance that is! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
36' Udinese concede a free kick following a bad challenge. It's a free kick to Juventus, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
36' Rosario Abisso interrupts the game. One of the players from Juventus won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Udinese earn a free kick.
34' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Juventus have a free kick.
34' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

33' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play. Udinese will take a free kick.
28' The game is interrupted as Timothy Weah (Juventus) is flagged offside.
27' Timothy Weah (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus in a dangerous position.
25' Martin Payero (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
24' The game is interrupted now, Martin Payero (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
22' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

22' Keinan Davis (Udinese) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Michele Di Gregorio. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
19' 0 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Maduka Okoye (Udinese) puts the ball into his own net.
17' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
16' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
16' The cross into the penalty area from Nicolo Savona (Juventus) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
12' Timothy Weah (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Maduka Okoye, who smothers the ball.
12' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
8' A player from Juventus commits a rough challenge. Rosario Abisso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
7' Half-chance! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) plays a pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
3' Keinan Davis (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
2' Half-chance! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) plays a pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' Rosario Abisso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese). A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
